title: Propiedad schema, types, and FakeRest generator
description: Create the propiedad (property inventory) entity from scratch. Mirrors the Sheet Propiedades tab (58 fields per project-context.json). Covers: TypeScript type, Supabase schema (new propiedades table), a propiedades_summary view, and FakeRest data generator. This is the data foundation for the property list UI (TASK-010) and the lead-property relation (TASK-008).
acceptance_criteria: src/components/atomic-crm/types.ts adds a Propiedad type with all 58 fields from project-context.json entities[1].fields

supabase/schemas/01_tables.sql adds a 'propiedades' table with correct PostgreSQL column types (text, numeric, boolean, date, list fields as text with check constraints for enum-like columns tipo, operacion, fuente)
supabase/schemas/03_views.sql adds a 'propiedades_summary' view exposing id, nombre, tipo, operacion, precio, activa, fuente, broker_nombre for list display

src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/ adds a propiedades.ts generator producing at least 20 realistic fake properties distributed across tipo=propia/compartida and operacion=venta/renta
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/index.ts imports and calls the new propiedades generator
The Propiedad type is exported from src/components/atomic-crm/types.ts

non_functional_requirements.security: No RLS on propiedades yet (read-only sync target; advisor read-all is acceptable in Phase 1)
